name: site-chip
useFor: Use in the chat composer (ChatInput's `site`) or above it. `onRemove` adds a remove key with a 24px hit area; the chip leaves before it calls back. When the label changes, the chip eases to its new width and the new coordinates rise in. `icon={false}` drops the parcel icon.
constraints: Free text that is not a location
A chip without a way to clear it in a composer
title: Site chip
description: The site a question is about, as coordinates in a Fog chip with the small cut and an optional remove key.
